items.title: Australian State Bans Data Centers From Residential Areas

items.title: Trump-Xi Summit Puts Global AI Race in Focus
items.title_ko: Trump-Xi Summit Puts Global AI Race in Focus
items.summary_ko: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down what to expect from the Trump-Xi summit later this week, with AI's role anticipated to be a major part of the agenda for those upcoming talks.
